mobsettings.configuration.title: Mob Settings
mobsettings.configuration.dropOnlyOnPlay: Extra Drops Only On Player Kill
Extra drops are only given when a player gets the kill.
mobsettings.configuration.extraDrops.too: Give mobs additional drops with a chance.
mobsettings.configuration.removeDrops.to: Remove items from a mob's drops. Runs before Extra Drops.
mobsettings.configuration.addSpawns.tool: Make mobs spawn naturally in biomes. Runs after Remove Spawns.
mobsettings.configuration.removeSpawns.t: Stop or reduce a mob's natural spawns in biomes. Runs before Add Spawns.
mobsettings.configuration.attributeOverr: Change a mob's health, speed, armor and more.
Set how far from players a mob despawns.
mobsettings.configuration.lightSpawnRest: Only let a mob spawn within a light level range.
mobsettings.ui.pickHint: Select a name field to search
mobsettings.ui.any.help: Matches everything (written as * in the config).
mobsettings.ui.note.pickAttribute: Pick an attribute to see its range
mobsettings.ui.describe.despawnRanges: %1$s stays within %2$s blocks of a player, despawns beyond
mobsettings.ui.describe.lightSpawnRestri: %1$s only spawns at light level %2$s to %3$s
mobsettings.ui.help.entity: The mob this rule applies to. Use * for every mob.
mobsettings.ui.help.addSpawns.entity: The mob to spawn. Only mobs that can spawn naturally are listed.
mobsettings.ui.help.removeSpawns.entity: The mob whose spawns are removed. Use * for every mob.
mobsettings.ui.help.removeDrops.item: The item to take out of the mob's drops. Use * to remove every drop.
mobsettings.ui.help.dimension: The dimension this applies to. Use * for every dimension. Rules for one dimension are applied after rules for every dimension, and don't affect animals placed when chunks generate.
mobsettings.ui.help.biome: The biome this applies to. Use * for every biome, or a biome tag like #minecraft:is_forest for a group of biomes.
mobsettings.ui.help.attribute: The stat to change. Only stats the chosen mob has are listed. Hover one in the list to see what it does.
mobsettings.ui.help.count: How many of the item drop.
mobsettings.ui.help.chance: Chance to drop, from 0 to 1. 0.25 means 25%.
mobsettings.ui.help.removeDrops.chance: Chance the item is removed, from 0 to 1 (0.25 means 25%). Leave empty to always remove it.
mobsettings.ui.help.weight: How common this spawn is compared to the others in the biome. Most hostile mobs use 100, farm animals around 10.
mobsettings.ui.help.minGroup: The fewest mobs that spawn together.
mobsettings.ui.help.maxGroup: The most mobs that spawn together.
mobsettings.ui.help.percent: How much of the spawn weight to remove, from 0 to 100. Leave empty to remove the spawn completely.
mobsettings.ui.help.value: The mob's new base value for this stat. It has to be inside the stat's range.
mobsettings.ui.help.range: Distance in blocks. Within this distance of a player the mob never despawns; farther away it despawns right away.
mobsettings.ui.help.minLight: The darkest light level (0-15) the mob can spawn at.
mobsettings.ui.help.maxLight: The brightest light level (0-15) the mob can spawn at.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.max_heal: Maximum health. Each heart is 2 health.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.movement: How fast the mob walks. Most mobs are around 0.2-0.3.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.armor: Armor points that reduce incoming damage. Full diamond armor is 20.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.armor_to: Makes armor hold up better against big hits.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.knockbac: Chance to resist knockback. 1 means it can't be knocked back.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.explosio: How much explosion knockback is ignored. 1 means none.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.attack_k: Extra knockback the mob deals with its attacks.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.attack_d: Damage dealt per melee hit, in half hearts.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.follow_r: How many blocks away the mob can notice and track targets.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.max_abso: Maximum golden absorption hearts the mob can have.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.scale: Size of the mob. 1 is normal, 2 is twice as big.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.step_hei: How tall a block the mob can walk up without jumping.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.gravity: How fast the mob falls. Normal is 0.08; lower floats more.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.safe_fal: Blocks the mob can fall before taking damage.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.fall_dam: Multiplies fall damage. 0 means no fall damage.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.burning_: Multiplies how long the mob stays on fire.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.oxygen_b: Makes the mob run out of air more slowly underwater.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.movement: Reduces slowdown from soul sand and similar blocks. 1 means none.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.water_mo: Reduces slowdown in water. 1 means none.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.entity_i: How far the mob can reach to interact with entities.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.camera_d: Camera distance when a player views from this mob.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.waypoint: How far away the mob shows up on the locator bar.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.spawn_re: Chance a zombie calls other zombies for help when hurt.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.tempt_ra: How far away the mob notices food it likes being held.
